response_firewall: Stage-A scores use public study/archive descriptions only. Published effect direction, p-value, fitted coefficient, and project-computed outcome association are not scoring fields.

systems.gate_reason: The source design measures landscape/local management, direct pollinator visitation and fruit/seed production at orchard scale across 20 orchards. PLOS S1 Table and S3 Table are also independently catalogued by Digital.CSIC as reusable XLSX datasets: landscape/local orchard characteristics (handle 10261/396616) and pollinator visits by group for the 20 orchards by year (handle 10261/396621). Methods fix visitation effort at five sampling days x three observers x one hour per orchard-year, so O and direct I can be treated as reusable without outcome inspection. Raw realised-production F and its exact orchard/year join to these tables remain pending verification in the Zenodo deposit, so the fitted gate remains closed.

systems.setting: Balearic Islands Cneorum tricoccon-Podarcis lilfordi system
systems.gate_reason: Dryad publicly exposes separate pollination-census and fruits/seeds files, so direct process and realised reproduction are demonstrably co-archived. However, the source appendix shows that direct visit rate belongs to a pollinator-census analysis with Plant ID/Census ID, whereas fruit set and seed set are estimated in a separate lizard-exclusion pollination experiment with Treatment and Plant ID. Co-archival therefore does not establish that the observational visit-rate rows and experimental reproductive rows are the same biological unit. The common Plant ID semantics and any valid cross-experiment join must be verified from the raw schemas before an I_visit -> F model can be opened. No comparable upstream fragmentation/landscape context coordinate is preregistered for a residual-context test.
systems.source_design_boundary: pollinator census and lizard-exclusion reproductive experiment are distinct source-design components; same-publication or same-archive status is not a valid alignment key

systems.setting: Mallorca coastal plant community, 23 abundant plant species across two field seasons
systems.gate_reason: Dryad contains a workbook for the 23-species/two-season study, and the public dataset description explicitly includes floral abundance, pollination-network information, seeds per flower and seed weight. Exact direct-visitation and species-year join columns still require workbook schema inspection. Species are potential process-function holdout units within one system, not 23 independent island systems.

The open source study measures orchard management/landscape context, visitation and fruit/seed/apple outcomes at six orchards. The public supplement explicitly exposes orchard landscape composition and orchard-level timed flower-visit counts, but its listed tables do not include a raw fruit-set, seed-set or apple-weight table. Reproductive function is therefore study-measured but not yet demonstrated as a reusable orchard-level F representation. The fitted gate remains closed pending an actual same-orchard F/A table rather than reconstruction from figures or model summaries.
public_supplement: Table S1: six-orchard coordinates and landscape composition
Table S3: timed visits and pan-trap individuals by species/morphospecies in each orchard
